invariants.rationale: partitionPath is used to construct a BucketInfo object and is likely expected to be non-null.
fileIdHint is used as a key in updateLocationToBucket and in the BucketInfo constructor, so it is likely required to be non-null.
partitionPath is used to identify a data partition, which typically should not be empty.
fileIdHint is used as a key and identifier, so it should not be empty.
partitionPath and fileIdHint typically represent distinct concepts (partition identifier and file identifier), so they are likely not equal.
